sampling.uncertainty_method: deterministic percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, 95% median interval
sampling.run_order: construction costs first; then deterministic rotation of CPU Raw, V2 Raw, V2 Prepared by workload ordinal and iteration

timing_boundaries.CPU-E2E-RAW: CPU Float32 call entry before validation through synchronous host result return
timing_boundaries.BND-E2E-RAW: V2 raw one-shot API including validation, conversion, transient allocation, H2D, production kernels, D2H, synchronization and call-owned cleanup
timing_boundaries.BND-E2E-PREP: V2 prepared search with prepared dataset and workspace already available; includes per-query validation, transfer, kernels, result transfer and synchronization
timing_boundaries.COST-PREP-DATASET-CONSTRUCTION: dataset preparation API call only; persistent prepared-dataset destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-WORKSPACE-CONSTRUCTION: workspace creation API call only; persistent workspace destruction excluded
timing_boundaries.COST-PREPARED-READY-CONSTRUCTION: wall time from dataset preparation entry through workspace creation return; persistent-resource destruction excluded

comparisons.statement: V2 Prepared steady-state latency is lower than CPU Raw latency
V2 Raw latency is lower than CPU Raw latency
V2 Prepared steady-state latency is lower than V2 Raw latency

ratio_rule.universal_inconclusive: no case rejected and at least one case inconclusive

break_even.persistent_resource_destruction: excluded; results are construction-plus-query amortization, not complete lifetime cost

historical_evidence_policy: S7, S8 and S10 evidence is immutable; S13 writes only to a new output directory
